program_name: Bachelor of Arts (English for Global Communication) (Hons)

fees.notes: UNIMAS official international undergraduate programme fee (Faculty of Education, Language and Communication): tuition RM3,500/semester + recurrent RM1,620/semester + non-recurring RM1,280 = RM42,240 total for 8 semesters. per_year = total / 4yr nominal duration. Source: https://www.global.unimas.my/admission/undergraduate (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or equivalent (MUET Band 4, TOEFL iBT 46, PTE 51, Cambridge 160)
